messages.author: 4cb195f26c6557f1
messages.subject: error with scale_fill_gradientn rescale option (follow up)
parts:
Hello again,

I just posted a question about scale_fill_gradeintn, after that I tested the example in ggplot2 reference manual.
I get the same error:

dsub <- subset(diamonds, x > 5 & x < 6 & y > 5 & y < 6)
dsub$diff <- with(dsub, sqrt(abs(x-y))* sign(x-y)) 
d <- qplot(x, y, data=dsub, colour=diff)
d
d + scale_colour_gradientn(colours = topo.colors(10), values = values, rescale = FALSE)

Error in scale$oob(scale$rescaler(x, from = limits)) : 
  attempt to apply non-function

Any suggestion

Thanks,
Robert

messages.author: 0c39e60ddb38622b
messages.subject: Re: error with scale_fill_gradientn rescale option (follow up)
parts:
Hi:

The short answer is that rescaler is expecting a function (default
rescale) as its value, not a logical; that's the immediate source of
the error message. The next problem with your example is that the
object values is not defined, so if you take out the rescaler code,
another error message appears. However, if you take out both values =
and rescaler =, you will get a graphic; what do you want that's
different from

d + scale_colour_gradientn(colours = topo.colors(10))

?

Dennis
